caption: Density of stars measured by Gaia (ESA), from Gaia DR3. The view from the Sun.

dedup.note: Two partitions of the MAST HATS copy repeat rows (same source_id up to 3 times); their order-8 pixels are recounted from distinct source_id.

pixel_to_sky.note: x = column from the left, y = row from the top; RA increases to the right

quantity: Gaia DR3 sources per square degree (catalogue counts, not surface brightness)
resampling: bilinear interpolation of the NSIDE 256 map (per deg^2) at each pixel centre, astropy-healpix 1.1.2

source.product: HATS point_map.fits (STScI/MAST, AWS Open Data bucket stpubdata, gaia/gaia_dr3/public/hats/gaia)

stretch.formula: v = asinh(max(D - black, 0) / soft) / asinh((white - black) / soft), clipped to [0, 1]; pixel = round(255 v)
stretch.inverse: D = black + soft * sinh(v * asinh((white - black) / soft)) (for v > 0)
